name: High Road Gen 3 TLR
aliases: 玛吉斯 HIGH ROAD 第三代

origin.basis: Maxxis says it began in 1967 as a bicycle-tire maker in Taiwan.

manufacturing.basis: The pages read do not state where the tire is made.

positioning: Third-generation High Road all-purpose road race tire (tubeless-ready) with Turn-Up construction, a 150 TPI casing, HYPR compound and K2 protection.
weight_basis: No size-specific weights were readable; Maxxis' page shows no size table.

wet_notes.summary: Maxxis claims its HYPR compound has 23% better wet grip than its previous road racing compound; no independent wet test of this generation found.

availability.note: Sold by a Tmall shop in mainland China; Maxxis' US site still lists the earlier generations; European retailers were seen in search results but not read.

price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts on 2026-11-01 for the 700X28C tubeless option; coupon price CNY 279. Single or pair not stated.

caveats: Sizes come from the Tmall listing; Maxxis publishes no size table on the page read.
Weights and pressure limits are not recorded.
Wet grip is a maker claim relative to its own previous compound.
